description: Report whether the Renovate CLI and config validator are reachable, their versions, and any env overrides in effect. Pass an optional `repoPath` to also diagnose the target repo's environment: parses the `.git/config` origin remote, reads any `endpoint`/`platform` in the repo's renovate config, probes endpoint reachability (using the same `https://`-only public-host allowlist as `dry_run`), and cross-references all three with token presence — surfaces actionable hints like 'set GITHUB_TOKEN before running dry_run'. The probe sends no credentials. Call this first when other tools fail with a spawn error or unexpected validation output.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to a repository root. When set, the tool also returns a `repoContext` block diagnosing the repo's git origin, config endpoint/platform, endpoint reachability, and token coverage.

name: check_setup
title: Check Renovate MCP setup
